comisionesInternas.title: Internal Commissions
comisionesInternas.subtitle: Tiered commission per salesperson, calculated on total orders closed in the month
comisionesInternas.banner: Will be paid automatically at month close: {{count}} commission(s) in "Due" status, for {{monto}}.
comisionesInternas.mesEnCursoAviso: This month is still open — the commission % is provisional and may move up a tier before month close.
comisionesInternas.arrastrado: carried over from a closed month, still uncollected
comisionesInternas.footnote: The commission % is fixed when the month closes based on the salesperson's total orders — it never changes afterward, even if the client's payment arrives in a later month. Everything updates automatically based on what's registered in Collections.

comisionesExternas.title: External Commissions
comisionesExternas.subtitle: 10% commission on architect-referred projects, fed automatically from Sales & Design
comisionesExternas.footnote: Each architect and project is created automatically once an "Architect or Designer" project reaches Approved in Pipeline. The external commission doesn't exist as a debt until the client pays. Once the client pays, it becomes "Pending architect invoice" — the architect's receipt must be uploaded before it can be marked paid.
